n: Canada Learning Code unplugged teacher guide
t: A free PDF guide with five unplugged coding lessons from Canada Learning Code.
steps: Find the Digital Toolbox Unplugged Activities guide on the Canada Learning Code site.
Read the opening pages on why unplugged activities help.
Pick one lesson, such as Do the Robot at 15 minutes.
Print the worksheets for that lesson.
Gather simple supplies such as cups for Speed Stacker.
Run the lesson and use the assessment at the end.
